title: Contract exception triage + Security Questionnaire integration for pricing pilots
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Context:
Sales and GTM are running 3 concurrent pricing pilots (Pilot-A, Pilot-B, Pilot-C) that expect expedited contract turnaround. Legal is receiving frequent ad-hoc redlines for MSA/DPA clauses (liability caps, indemnity carveouts, data residency notes) and separate security questionnaires (SQs) that require answers and artifacts. Currently there is no standardized triage, which leads to: delayed signings, inconsistent concessions, manual back-and-forth with legal, and lost visibility into pricing impact.

Goal:
Define and implement a lightweight triage workflow that: (1) captures SQ responses as part of the initial request, (2) routes redlines into 3 well-defined lanes (Standard Accept, Sales Escalation, Legal Review), (3) surfaces pricing impact estimates to Sales/Finance, and (4) provides a playbook for rapid approvals for pilot deals under $250k ARR.

Scope:
- MSA and DPA redline triage for pilot and pre-enterprise deals.
- Security questionnaire intake and templated responses for the top 10 enterprise SQs.
- Pricing impact tagging to estimate concession magnitude (none, minor, moderate, major).
- Integrations: HubSpot ticket link + shared Drive folder + Legal queue in JIRA.

Out of scope:
- Full enterprise contract negotiation playbook for >$1M ARR deals (handled by Sales Ops).
- Long-form legal policy rewrites beyond templates and standard positions.

Links and artifacts:
- Confluence PRD (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/PM-9257+Contract+Exception+Triage (internal)
- SQ response templates (Drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/enterprise-sq-templates
- Current Legal queue snapshot (JIRA): https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/LEGALQ-archive
acceptance_criteria: SQ intake form added to pilot deal kickoff checklist and HubSpot lead page
Triage UI in Sales Ops spreadsheet with three lanes and automated rules populated
Definition and documentation of concession categories with example language for approvals
Automated Slack alert to Legal when 'Legal Review' lane is chosen or when concession category is 'major'
Pilot deals under $250k ARR with 'minor' concessions can be approved by Sales + Legal SME within 48 hours
Dashboard showing time-to-sign, concession distribution, and revenue at risk for pilots
10 templated SQ answers validated by Security and Legal and stored in Drive
proposed_workflow: 1) Sales engineer initiates 'Pilot Contract Request' in HubSpot with attached redline and completed SQ template. 2) Intake automation extracts key clauses (liability cap, indemnity, data residency) and assigns concession category via rulebook (auto-suggest). 3) Record lands in Triage sheet (Sales Ops) with lanes: A) Standard Accept (auto-approve), B) Sales Escalation (requires Finance approval), C) Legal Review (routes to Legal queue). 4) For lanes B/C create a JIRA ticket pre-populated with contract excerpt, SQ artifacts, and estimated pricing impact. 5) Legal reviewer updates JIRA with recommended language, final concession sign-off, and approval SLA. 6) Once approved, Sales uploads signed counters and updates HubSpot deal stage. 7) All artifacts indexed in Drive with a standard naming convention for auditability.
metrics: Average time from intake to Legal decision (target < 72h for major lanes)
% of pilot deals closed within 30 days
Estimated ARR impact held in 'revenue at risk' dashboard
Number of SQs answered by template vs custom response
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Build intake form, populate SQ templates, manual triage in Google Sheet. Phase 2 (3 weeks): Add HubSpot + JIRA automations, Slack alerts, and Legal SME rotation. Phase 3 (2 weeks): Dashboarding and pilot retrospectives; freeze template language. Target pilot rollouts: Pilot-A first week of Phase 1; Pilot-B joins in Phase 2. Post-rollout review at end of Phase 3 with Legal and Sales Ops to decide expansion to Dedicated customers.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Sales bypasses workflow to expedite deals -> Mitigation: Require signed intake form and SQ as gating metadata in HubSpot before deal stage moves to 'Contract'

Risk: SQ templates insufficient for specialized controls (customers in regulated industries) -> Mitigation: Mark such SQs as 'requires deep review' and route directly to Security and Legal with extended SLA
Risk: Legal backlog grows -> Mitigation: Introduce Legal SME rotation and RACI with Finance to resolve moderate concessions without full legal review
Risk: Inaccurate pricing impact estimates -> Mitigation: Post-approval reconciliation and monthly calibration with Finance
dependencies: LEGAL-1402 (create Legal JIRA queue and issue template)
ENG-7121 (HubSpot webhook support and intake automation)
SEC-190 (review & sign off on SQ templates)
FIN-88 (pricing concession taxonomy and approval thresholds)
